title: Sir Dekh ke Shabbir Ka Shereen Ne Pukara
body:
Haye... Haye..
Jab shereen ke ghr kafela shabir ka aya
Zainab se kaha kaun ho batlao zaiefa
Hum sheer hu shabir ki zainab ne pukara
Milne ke liye aie hai tujse tere maula
<<MINI>>
Sir Dekh ke Shabbir Ka Shereen Ne Pukara x2
Aap aienge is haal me socha hi nhi tha
Sir Dekh ke Shabbir Ka Shereen Ne Pukara x2
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Wada jo kiya apne mai bhool na paie
Is gar me wo ghr chor ke jis din se hu aie
Taqti hu usi roz se mai apka rasta
